title: Augustana Art Students Featured in Invitational at Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
summary_en: The Eide/Dalrymple Gallery at Augustana University is showcasing “The Augustana Student Invitational" — on view through Friday, Aug. 28. A closing gallery reception will take place the same day from 7-9 p.m.
